svg.title: Prototype cost of an additional verification by credential size
svg.desc: Prototype times per additional verification, by credential size. The orange path verifies the retained envelope and freshly expands its payload; comparison with a cached graph is outside that timed path. The blue path retrieves and verifies the stored credential and proof inputs. At 146 quads, the separately measured envelope-only path took 0.25 ms, excluding validation of the cached view and source binding. Source: paper [full paper], Table 3.
